title: lifwcm: local information-based fuzzy weighted c-means algorithm for image segmentation
core_idea: Compute a single-pass, data-driven weight for each pixel by aggregating neighborhood intensity variation and positional overlap, then integrate these weights into the standard fuzzy c-means objective and a spatially aware membership refinement to suppress noisy and boundary pixels while preserving fine details with low computational overhead.
tldr: A fuzzy c-means variant that uses one-time local information weights per pixel (intensity variation + positional overlap) incorporated into the clustering objective and spatial membership updates to reduce noise sensitivity and maintain detail with minimal extra cost.
